messages:
kevin: Quick heads-up — final sweep for model-catalog launch tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Can owners call out any remaining blockers (licensing, perf profiles, CRs, or infra routing)?

maria: I have two models left: cobalt-4b and harbor-lite-3b. Cobalt needs a quantization perf profile; harbor-lite's embed shape differs from our standard 1024 -> needs embedding migration. Not blocking but want to track.

tay: @maria for cobalt-4b can you paste the perf command you ran? I can try a 4-bit quant profile and push a draft.

maria: Sure, ran this locally:```bash
./run_perf --model cobalt-4b --batch 8 --seq 512 --dtype float16
# ~85 ms/token on g5-16x
```
I'll try q4_0 tonight and share numbers.

leah: Legal ping — harbor-lite license is Apache-2.0 but has a small 3rd-party codec with BSD-3. I flagged to @legal-bot earlier, no red flags yet. If anyone sees GPL text in weights, shout.

samir: CI flake: curation CR #453 (catalog manifest validation) still has one failing test for optional metadata keys. I left a comment. @kevin can we merge with a follow-up? It's non-blocking for launch but blocks the auto-ingest job.

kevin: Prefer to merge only if CI is green. If it's truly optional, we can change the test to warn and open a post-launch ticket. @samir please copy the failing log here.

samir: Log snippet:```json
{"error":"missing_field","field":"inference_profile","model":"harbor-lite-3b"}
```
Test expects inference_profile for all entries. I can relax the assertion to optional+warn.

maria: On embeddings: harbor-lite returns shape 1536. Migration plan: add an embedding-shim in catalog that pads/truncates to 1536->1536 canonical mapping and update clients incrementally. Do we need a rollout policy?

tay: Add a per-route shim with a flag in the console to enable. We can roll to 10% for a day. That avoids client updates.

leah: +1 from legal. No licensing hold.

kevin: Action summary: 
- @maria: post q4 perf numbers for cobalt-4b by EOD (priority).
- @samir: adjust manifest test to warn; open ticket to fill inference_profile (owner: samir).
- @tay: prepare console rollout flag for embedding-shim (10% canary).
- @legal-bot: confirm no last-minute license strings (already ok).

devops-bot: Reminder: scheduled deploy window tomorrow 09:30-10:15 PT. If any infra changes required, submit by 17:00 today.

kevin: Okay if no new blockers by 17:00 we'll proceed with launch window. If anything pops up ping me directly. LGTM -> folks respond with :thumbsup: when you ack.

maria: :thumbsup:

tay: :thumbsup: I got the CR ping.

samir: :thumbsup: will open ticket for the inference_profile fill-ins.

legal-bot: License check complete — all models in this thread are Apache/BSD compatible.

kevin: Thanks team — closing thread unless new issues come up.
